LanguageData.MDWC_StatSeverityPerKitDesc: The total injury severity one kit of medicine can tend, the same as a single tending. A disease, infection or missing body part uses a whole kit.
LanguageData.MDWC_GaugeKitDesc: Each kit tends up to {0} injury severity, or one disease, infection or missing body part.
LanguageData.MDWC_ShotAutocastDesc: When autocast is enabled, each patient gets a shot as their dressing ends.
LanguageData.MDWC_SettingsUnavailable: These settings are unavailable. Another mod has changed the medic warcasket's definitions, so the set keeps its built-in values.
LanguageData.MDWC_MedicineDesc: The medicine loaded into the armor, one per kit. Better medicine gives higher tend quality. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_TintDesc: The color of the dressing's effects and of the medicine gauge. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_KitsDesc: The number of medicine kits the armor holds when full. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_CastTimeDesc: How long the pilot takes to start a dressing. The patient is held still while it is cast. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_TendIntervalDesc: The time spent on each wound or illness at normal medical tend speed. Higher medical skill and the medic shoulders tend faster. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_CooldownDesc: The time the pilot must wait after a dressing before starting another. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_RangeDesc: How close the pilot must be to the patient to start a dressing, in cells. Line of sight is required. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_AIDressingDesc: When enabled, raider and allied medics will dress their own downed between fights. If they also wear the shoulders, they will give a shot after each dressing, as your pilots do. When disabled, only your own pilots use the dressing. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_DressingSummary: The suite holds up to {0} kits of {1}, each treating {2} severity of injuries or one illness. A dressing takes {3} to cast, then tends a wound every {4} at normal tend speed. The cooldown after a dressing is {5}.
LanguageData.MDWC_DressingSummaryNoCooldown: The suite holds up to {0} kits of {1}, each treating {2} severity of injuries or one illness. A dressing takes {3} to cast, then tends a wound every {4} at normal tend speed. The next can start at once.
LanguageData.MDWC_ShotsDesc: The number of shots the shoulders hold when full. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_ShotAmmoDesc: The item loaded into the shoulders, one per shot. Any medicine, go-juice or wake-up will do. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_ShotBoostDesc: How long the adrenaline lasts before the crash. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_ShotCrashDesc: How long the crash lasts. A crashing patient will be dull, slow and quick to tire. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_ShotCooldownDesc: The time the pilot must wait between shots. Automatic shots skip a patient while on cooldown. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_AIShotDesc: When enabled, raider and allied medics will give their own downed an adrenaline shot between fights, and a raider back on their feet will rejoin the raid. When disabled, only your own pilots use the shot. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_ShotSummary: The injector holds {0} shots and reloads with {1}, one per shot. A shot's boost lasts {2} over {3} levels, then the patient crashes for {4}, and tires faster the whole time. The cooldown after a shot is {5}.
LanguageData.MDWC_ShotSummaryNoCooldown: The injector holds {0} shots and reloads with {1}, one per shot. A shot's boost lasts {2} over {3} levels, then the patient crashes for {4}, and tires faster the whole time. The next shot can follow at once.
LanguageData.MDWC_SectionWorkDesc: The work types a medic pilot can do. All other work follows the warcasket trait from Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates, including any changes other mods make to it.
LanguageData.MDWC_WorkDesc: When enabled, medic pilots can do this work. The change applies to pilots who are already entombed. Newly enabled work starts unassigned in the Work tab.
LanguageData.MDWC_WorkSummary: The pilot can do {0} work. All other work follows the VFE Pirates warcasket trait.
LanguageData.MDWC_WorkSummaryNone: The pilot does no caring work. All other work follows the VFE Pirates warcasket trait.
